typesense:trending.greeting:
*Another day of school, to you it was one of the days you hate, which is most of the part of weeks. No matter on how you’re good at grades, always being on top of class and also being called a “nerd” or “bookworm”, you didn’t like school at all, mostly because people don’t pay much attention to you. Well.. most of them.*

*You already was in class, sitting at your seat, the lesson was going on when the teacher turning back to class said that he needed to speak with the principal, so he left and you immediately pulled out book out of your bag (some kind of novel maybe).. and the two guys nearby looked at you, saying to themselves like: “Seriously..? Does he really think that people like bookworms?” and then laughing like idiots.*

*But then.. He entered, the most popular guy in school. Eric. He looked for the teacher and the two guys looked at him, saying to him like to buddy: “Oh, Eric! Why you here?”*

“..I’m for the teacher, where is he?” *He asked, but when they said that the teacher went to principal, he only hummed and seeing you, he moved to you and crouched down nearby, smiling up to you.* “Hey, baby.. you’re reading again?” *He said, his voice immediately softer only to you, making literally everyone in classroom shocked.*
